items.py: Tā shòu le hěn duō.
items.en: He's lost a lot of weight.

items.py: Běijīng de biànhuà zhēn dà.
Shēnghuó yuè lái yuè hǎo le.
items.en: Life is getting better and better.

items.zh: 刘京：大卫，好久不见！你胖了！
items.py: Liú Jīng: Dàwèi, hǎo jiǔ bú jiàn! Nǐ pàng le!
items.en: Liu Jing: David, long time no see! You've gained weight!

items.zh: 大卫：是吗？中国菜太好吃了。
items.py: Dàwèi: Shì ma? Zhōngguó cài tài hǎo chī le.
items.en: David: Really? Chinese food is too delicious.

items.zh: 刘京：你的汉语也进步了很多。
items.py: Liú Jīng: Nǐ de Hànyǔ yě jìnbù le hěn duō.
items.en: Liu Jing: Your Chinese has also improved a lot.

items.zh: 大卫：谢谢。你也变了，个子好像高了。
items.py: Dàwèi: Xièxie. Nǐ yě biàn le, gèzi hǎoxiàng gāo le.
items.en: David: Thanks. You've changed too, you seem taller.

items.zh: 刘京：哈哈，我没长高，可能是你的错觉。
items.py: Liú Jīng: Hāhā, wǒ méi zhǎng gāo, kěnéng shì nǐ de cuòjué.
items.en: Liu Jing: Haha, I haven't grown, maybe it's your imagination.

items.zh: 玛丽：和子，你觉得北京怎么样？
items.py: Mǎlì: Hézǐ, nǐ juéde Běijīng zěnmeyàng?
items.en: Mary: Hezi, what do you think of Beijing?

items.py: Hézǐ: Běijīng de biànhuà zhēn dà.
items.en: Hezi: Beijing has changed so much.

items.zh: 玛丽：你上次来是什么时候？
items.py: Mǎlì: Nǐ shàng cì lái shì shénme shíhou?
items.en: Mary: When was the last time you came?

items.zh: 和子：三年前。那时候地铁线路没有这么多。
items.py: Hézǐ: Sān nián qián. Nà shíhou dìtiě xiànlù méiyǒu zhème duō.
items.en: Hezi: Three years ago. There weren't so many subway lines then.

items.zh: 玛丽：现在越来越方便了。
items.py: Mǎlì: Xiànzài yuè lái yuè fāngbiàn le.
items.en: Mary: It's getting more and more convenient.

items.zh: 和子：是的，生活越来越好了。
items.py: Hézǐ: Shì de, shēnghuó yuè lái yuè hǎo le.
items.en: Hezi: Yes, life is getting better and better.

items.zh: 玛丽：天气也越来越暖和了。
items.py: Mǎlì: Tiānqì yě yuè lái yuè nuǎnhuo le.
items.en: Mary: The weather is also getting warmer and warmer.

items.py: Tā pàng le. → Tā shòu le.
items.en: He got fat. → He got thin.

items.zh: 天气暖和了。→ 天气冷了。
items.py: Tiānqì nuǎnhuo le. → Tiānqì lěng le.
items.en: It got warm. → It got cold.
